purpose: Deterministic synthetic software-regression golden case for the CSCO five-session retrospective benchmark covering 2026-07-20 through 2026-07-24.

provenance.process: Deterministic geometric simulation with cyclical macro trend, regime-switching volatility, AR(1) return dynamics, and volume-volatility coupling across 2,906 NYSE trading sessions.
provenance.license: CC0-1.0 / Public Domain Synthetic Data. No external market data redistribution rights required.

limitations: This fixture is a synthetic software-regression golden case for testing and CI sanity.
It contains NO real market data and MUST NOT be used to claim forecasting accuracy or certify any model.
All price movements and volume patterns are synthetically generated.

reproducibility.neural_output_portability: LSTM outputs are implementation-sensitive across PyTorch versions, CPU kernels and thread counts. Golden neural predictions are validated with a loose tolerance and are NOT asserted as exact cross-platform values.
